rationale: KIND_FLEET_PLAN exists in bus.py, daedalus planning.py publishes kind=fleet.plan letters, and buskit envelope contract whitelists fleet.plan for daedalus - yet the catalogue table omits it, violating INTEGRATION.md's own rule that new cross-organ comms need a catalogue entry plus a kind constant.

lesson.title: INTEGRATION.md sec6 catalogue missing live fleet.plan kind on the daedalus lane
lesson.lesson: Every KIND_* constant with a live publisher gets a section-6 catalogue entry in the same revision it lands, filed under the topic buskit actually whitelists - not the topic that seems convenient. fleet.plan is published by daedalus/planning.py onto the raw-bus daedalus lane and whitelisted only in TOPICS['daedalus'] (buskit/envelope.py:58), so the fix is to add fleet.plan to the sec6 as-built daedalus lane row ('workshop build outcomes + planning-station transitions'); listing it under updates would itself be catalogue drift because validate() checks kinds against TOPICS[topic].
